correctness.rationale: Odd n antipodal translation maps the radius-r ball bijectively to its complement and forces all nonzero even-weight Walsh coefficients to vanish; odd coefficients have exact Krawtchouk partial-sum identity W(2s+1)=K_r(2s;2r)=(-1)^s C(2r,r)C(r,s)/C(2r,2s), hence none vanish. This establishes exactly the two parity coset orthogonal bases. In one-vector substitution, inner product rho_s with the omitted basis character is nonzero, while the retained projection has squared norm 1-rho_s²; the Gram perturbation has eigenvalues 1±sqrt(1-rho_s²) and M-2 copies of 1. Exact consecutive ratio rho_(s+1)/rho_s=(2s+1)/(2r-2s-1) classifies maximum s=0,r and center minima; Stirling gives rho_best~1/sqrt(pi*r) and rho_worst~sqrt(2/(pi*r))*2^(-r), so K_best~4pi*r, K_worst~2pi*r*4^r. Independently enumerated every ball point for r=1..4 and matched the binomial identities exactly, not as a proof of all r.
